text:
Theme of Dream and Life

Dream me,

        dream me, half-open lips.

Sleeping mouth, you who smile, dream me.


        Down through dream, beautiful water, pure limbs,

beneath the moon, slender one,

        dream me.

Awake,

        dream me as you breathe,

without knowing it, forgotten, brown skin;

dream me

        love, love, with winter

like a purple flower upon the shoulder.

Oh slender

        garden whose slender waist

I have held for so long;

oh flame of

        black eyes, my love;

oh course of water among dreams.

translation.title: Theme of Dream and Life
translation.editorial_note: The source catalog title differs, but the visible body is 'Theme of Dream and Life'; this entry preserves the heading.
